basic_identification.full_title: Door Closers, Concealed Type (Hydraulically Regulated) — Specification
basic_identification.sector_category: Civil Engineering / Builders Hardware (approved by the Civil Engineering Division Council and finalized by the Builders Hardware Sectional Committee of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

scope.summary: This standard specifies the requirements for manufacture, dimensions, capacity, construction, and performance-testing of concealed-type hydraulically operated door closers, which are fixed in a concealed position within the thickness of the panel on vertical hinge type doors opening to one side only and not weighing more than 80 kg.

version_status_and_amendments.supersedes: N/A (Developed as a new dedicated national standard to regulate concealed-type hydraulically regulated door closers)

certification_and_marking.certification_status: Strict Statutory Mandatory Certification. Under the 'Door Fittings (Quality Control) Order' (QCO) issued by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (DPIIT), Government of India, all hydraulically regulated concealed door closers manufactured, imported, or distributed in the Indian market must conform to IS 14912:2001 and bear the mandatory BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark). Manufacturing, importing, distributing, or stocking non-certified door closers is a punishable statutory offense under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016. Precious metal hallmarking is completely inapplicable to industrial builders hardware components.

requirements.detail: Every certified door closer unit must carry the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) along with the manufacturer's registered licence number (CM/L) and standard designation to verify compliance.
The concealed hydraulic closers covered under this standard are engineered specifically for vertical hinge type doors opening to one side only, with a maximum door mass not exceeding 80 kg.
The closer features a specialized regulating valve assembly with a regulating valve packing and end plug, allowing users to fine-tune the speed and dampening force during door closure.
Each door closer must be clearly and indelibly marked with: a) Manufacturer's name or trademark; b) Type of the closer; and c) Unique serial number.

To prevent damage to the painted surfaces during transit and handling, each closer must be individually packed in cardboard or wooden boxes with reinforcing boards or straw. The packaging must be of a type and quality that prevents the ingress of moisture during storage.

If the number of defective closers in the first sample is less than or equal to the acceptance number, the lot is accepted. If it is equal to or greater than the rejection number, the lot is rejected. If it falls between the two, a second sample of equivalent size is tested. The cumulative defectives are compared to the second acceptance/rejection thresholds to determine final lot conformity.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 14912 : 2001 is the mandatory national Indian Standard specification governing concealed-type hydraulically operated door closers fixed within the door panel thickness of single-action vertical-hinge doors weighing up to 80 kg. Under India's statutory Door Fittings Quality Control Order (QCO), all such concealed hydraulically regulated closers manufactured or sold domestically must bear the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) to ensure fire-safety and mechanical reliability. It regulates the assembly's core components—such as the double-spring drive (main and inner springs), piston, pinion assembly, sliding nylon runner, and adjustable speed-regulating valves. The standard enforces detailed quality parameters, including individual moisture-proof cardboard or wooden packaging to prevent rust and paint chipping during transit, along with a strict double-sampling lot conformity audit structure for construction, dimensions, finish, and performance integrity.
